snippet.title: We Steal From Old People: The Game - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Available NOW on Steam! Beat swarms of old people and take their bricks in this action roguelite. Rip them from their disgusting old hands. You need bricks. You need all the bricks for yourself because you’re a slimy little brick weasel. You are like a brick vampire and bricks are the blood you need!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5051080
Discord: https://discord.gg/xjHFMHP3nU
One Big Sip: https://onebigsip.com
